engines.name: BLAM
engines.summary: Twelve OPL2 FM percussion models and two SAM speech banks on one extra machine.
engines.author: 100demons

knobs.does: the FM model's colour; on SAM1/SAM2, the word
Model: KIK, TOM, BNG, CNG, TAI, TIM, MAR, DJB, BLK, GNG, BUB, ZAP, SAM1, SAM2
the stepped Ratio on FM models; the scrub position on SAM1/SAM2
the envelope contour; the speaking speed on SAM1/SAM2

engines.name: BLAST
engines.summary: Fourteen tonal OPL2 two-operator FM models, with a stepped modulator ratio on SWEEP.
engines.author: 100demons

knobs.does: Index: the FM modulation index / modulator level, the mallet hardness or the feedback
Model: SIN, HLF, ABS, PLS, BAS, PIA, MAR, GLK, BRS, ACC, STR, STL, TMP, ZAP
Ratio: the modulator ratio in three-character steps (1:2 … 15X); FUNC leaves the steps
Env: how the sound moves (brightness decay, swell, feedback, detune, mallet click)

engines.name: Feral
engines.summary: Nine noisy, unpredictable synthesis models on one extra machine, light on the processor.
engines.author: 100demons

knobs.does: the model's first macro; its on-screen name changes with the model
Model: 0 NYB, 1 GND, 2 BNJ, 3 RYT, 4 FRS, 5 RNG, 6 PLS, 7 SCN, 8 KOS
the tone envelope; a third control on BNJ and RNG

engines.name: LiXR
engines.summary: A fixed-point drum voice with feedback FM, a pitch envelope and a sample-rate decimator where the filter would be.
engines.author: 100demons

knobs.does: waveform: sine on the left, triangle in the centre, saw then rectangle on the right. Past 0.65 it adds noise, and past 0.85 a clap-like burst; SHAPE reduces the noise
feedback FM, from none to a quarter cycle of modulation, on a square law; the top of the range is the wild part
pitch envelope: depth (0 to 48 semitones) and decay time together
labelled **Rate**: the decimator's sample rate, clean at 0 to a coarse, aliased buzz at 127
